title: 第7章 洪荒大佬的抉择第8章 赢天的转变冥界大战
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
尤其是处在六位圣人之上的鸿钧老祖，闻言更是眼皮直跳。
在反应过来后鸿钧老祖瞬间便闪身挡在了那道虚影面前。
面无表情的说道：“罗喉，未免天下苍生涂炭，这种热闹你还是别凑了！”
魔祖罗喉闻言不屑道：“桀桀~鸿钧，都这么多年了，你还是一如既往的无耻。”
“什么事情都要扯到，天下苍生去。”
“可你有真正在意过这天下苍生吗？”
鸿钧老祖淡淡的说道：“众生都有各自的命运，吾等不应随意插手变动。”
“顺势而行，方为大道。”
魔祖罗喉大笑道：“哈哈哈~呸！什么狗屁的命运，吾等修行之辈，本就逆天而行。”
“自己的命运，应当掌握在自己手中！”
“说什么不能随意变动，应顺势而为。”
“不过都是些空口白话，得了好处又不想付出的无耻理由罢了。”
“说的那么冠冕堂皇，给谁看？”
鸿钧老祖淡淡道：“既然道友不听劝阻，那本座也只好替天行道，将你镇压了。”
魔祖罗喉闻言戏谑道：“怎么，说不过就想动手了？”
“看来本座还真没说错，你真的不是一般的无耻。”
“呵~来来来，本座还怕你不成？”
说完手中便出现一杆暗红色的长枪。
瞬间刺向了鸿钧老祖的胸膛。
而鸿钧老祖的头顶也突然冒出半块碎玉散发出淡淡的光芒，挡住了魔祖的致命一击。

魔祖罗喉看着鸿钧老祖头上的碎玉道：“呵~造化玉碟？既然已经碎成几瓣了，本座今天便将让它再碎一点！”
“九重魔域·弑神！”
说完浑身散发出遮天蔽日的魔气。
将那浓郁的魔气全部注入到弑神枪中。
随后持枪猛然砸向了造化玉蝶。
当枪刃正要碰到造化玉蝶之时，一朵白色莲花突然出现，将鸿钧老祖与造化玉蝶包裹在其中。
挡下了这恐怖的一枪。
“桀桀桀~十二品净世白莲？”
“啧啧~鸿钧啊鸿钧，这么多年来你的实力没怎么进步。”
“但这保命的本事，倒是一流啊。”
“这一次你又打算躲在那乌龟壳中待多久？”
话音刚落合拢为花骨朵的白莲花再次绽放，鸿钧老祖再次出现。
“罗喉，你还是如此能说会道。”
content_en:
Especially Patriarch Hongjun, who was above the six saints, his eyelids jumped when he heard this.
After reacting, Patriarch Hongjun instantly stepped in front of the phantom.
He said expressionlessly: "Luo Hou, the whole world will be in ruins. You'd better not join in this kind of excitement!"
Demon Ancestor Luo Hou heard this and said disdainfully: "Jiejie~Hongjun, after so many years, you are still as shameless as ever."
"Everything has to be involved, and everyone in the world will die."
"But have you ever truly cared about the people in this world?"
Ancestor Hongjun said calmly: "All living beings have their own destiny, and we should not interfere and change it at will."
"Follow the trend and you will be on the right path."
Demon Ancestor Luo Hou laughed and said: "Hahaha~ Bah! What a bullshit fate, we cultivators are already going against the will of heaven."
"Your own destiny should be in your own hands!"
"Whatever you say cannot be changed at will, you should follow the trend."
"It's just empty talk, shameless excuses for getting benefits but not wanting to pay for them."
"It sounds so grand, who can you show it to?"
Ancestor Hongjun said calmly: "Since fellow Taoist will not listen to dissuasion, I have no choice but to act on behalf of heaven and suppress you."
Demon Ancestor Luohou heard this and said jokingly: "Why, you want to take action even though you can't talk?"
"It seems that I am indeed right. You are really not shameless."
"Ha~ come on, come on, am I still afraid of you?"
After saying that, a dark red spear appeared in his hand.
It instantly stabbed the chest of Patriarch Hongjun.
And half a piece of broken jade suddenly appeared on the head of Patriarch Hongjun, emitting a faint light, blocking the Demon Ancestor's fatal blow.
Demon Ancestor Luohou looked at the broken jade on Ancestor Hongjun's head and said: "Ha~ The jade dish of creation? Since it has been broken into several pieces, I will let it break a little more today!"
"Nine Demon Realms·God Killing!"
After saying that, his whole body exuded a demonic aura that covered the sky and the sun.
Inject all the rich demonic energy into the God-killing Spear.
Then he suddenly hit the creation jade butterfly with a gun.
Just when the gun blade was about to touch the Creation Jade Butterfly, a white lotus flower suddenly appeared, wrapping Patriarch Hongjun and the Creation Jade Butterfly in it.
Blocked this terrifying shot.
"Jiejiejie~Twelfth-grade Pure World White Lotus?"
"Tsk, tsk~ Hongjun, Hongjun, your strength has not improved much over the years."
"But his ability to save his life is top-notch."
"How long do you plan to hide in that turtle shell this time?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the white lotus flower bloomed again, and Patriarch Hongjun appeared again.
"Luo Hu, you are still so eloquent."
